why: a mixed blob (three rangers, a WORK:MOVE and a MOVE:HEAL body) walks to an outpost's raid through a room none of ours sees, as one: no member parked for the unseen walk. A lone member's walk is about 84 (33 steps to the home's exit, 49 across the unseen room); seeds 1-4 measure 91, 94, 90, 92, a set parked for the walk 101-103. Main stalls 1.2 ticks a member (queued at the home's swamp patch) and spreads 0 tiles a tick past R+1. The members start free on the colony's muster, beyond the base from the exit, and leave it round the plan's structures: spread 0.37 and stall 1.8 a member, so the bounds are 0.48 (0.1 over it) and 2.4 (1.6's share over main's 1.2)
